lore: The soul force that moved an empire.
characteristics: Nonviolence: when this card loses a Strength round, gain +10 Belief for the next round.
achievement: Independence — when Belief wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: She dressed the world in modernity.
characteristics: Elegance: this card's Culture counts as 10 higher if opponent's Wealth is higher.
achievement: Icon — when Culture wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: A revolution forged from peasant to chairman.
characteristics: Long March: if this card loses the first 2 rounds, it gains +10 to all stats for the remainder.
achievement: Revolution — when Politics wins 4 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: The last great general of Rome.
characteristics: Outnumbered: if opponent has more cards remaining, this card gains +10 Strength.
achievement: Reconquest — when Strength wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: Deified by two civilizations for mastery of stone and medicine.
characteristics: Polymath: apply the highest of Intelligence or Technique when either is the active stat.
achievement: Monument — when Technique wins 4 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: He turned leaves and water into philosophy.
characteristics: Ritual: when Culture is the active stat, add 10 to this card's score.
achievement: The Classic — when Culture wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: He built the machine that broke the unbreakable.
characteristics: Codebreaker: if opponent's Intelligence is higher, treat this card's Intelligence as equal.
achievement: Cracked — when Intelligence wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: A bullet for a nation's soul.
characteristics: Resolve: when this card loses a round, its Strength increases by 5 for the next round.
achievement: Martyr — when defeated in a round by 20+ points, generate 1 winning point.

lore: His fortune shaped an era, for better and worse.
characteristics: Financier: at game start, reduce one opponent card's Wealth by 10.
achievement: Capital — when Wealth wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: Grace in every frame, humanity in every cause.
characteristics: Humanitarian: if Belief is the active stat, this card gains +10 Reputation.
achievement: Icon — when Reputation wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: She played from the heart when the world told her to stand aside.
characteristics: Prodigy: this card's Culture and Technique are immune to opponent debuffs.
achievement: Virtuoso — when Culture wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: He handed the world a ruler and said: begin.
characteristics: Elements: at game start, this card's Intelligence counts as 10 higher against Scientist and Mathematician identities.
achievement: Axiom — when Intelligence wins 5 rounds total, generate 1 winning point.

lore: In a monastery garden, he found the code of life.
characteristics: Patient Observation: if the match reaches round 8+, this card gains +15 Intelligence.
achievement: Inheritance — when this card wins a round by 30+ points, generate 1 winning point.

lore: She rode in her father's armor and shook the walls of legend.
characteristics: Disguise: opponent does not know this card's Gender until it is played.
achievement: Honor — when Strength wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: He carried Beethoven's shadow and carved his own light.
characteristics: Perfectionist: this card may be returned to hand once per match to replay in a later round.
achievement: Harmony — when Culture wins 3 consecutive rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: The greatest knight of the realm, undone by the greatest love.
characteristics: Chivalry: if opponent plays a Female card, lose 10 Strength but gain 15 Reputation.
achievement: Champion — when Strength wins 4 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: Sorrow and beauty, distilled into verse.
characteristics: Elegist: after a loss, this card gains +8 Culture for the next round.
achievement: Verse — when Culture wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: A kingdom inherited, a revolution unleashed.
characteristics: Indecision: if Politics is the active stat, the active stat is re-rolled once.
achievement: Downfall — when this card loses 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: She wore the crown of Versailles until the crowd came for it.
characteristics: Opulence: at game start, this card's Wealth counts as 10 higher.
achievement: Excess — when Wealth wins 3 rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: The sword and the mind — both perfected.
characteristics: Two-Sword Style: this card wins ties by highest secondary stat (Technique).
achievement: Undefeated — if this card wins 4+ consecutive rounds, generate 1 winning point.

lore: He built the world's first empire from nothing but will.
characteristics: Conqueror: this card's Politics and Strength each count as 5 higher.
achievement: Empire — when Politics wins 4 rounds, generate 1 winning point.
